text: Python CLI implemented as single file cron_parser.py
Parse standard 5-field cron expressions (minute hour dom month dow); reject wrong field count
validate <expr> subcommand explains each field for valid expressions
validate <expr> reports the error for invalid expressions (non-zero exit, message, no traceback)
next <expr> prints next run time(s) from now, default count
next <expr> -n N prints exactly the next N run times, strictly after now, in order
Next times correct (matching all fields; standard DOM/DOW OR semantics when both restricted)
Handle invalid dates like February 30: never produce impossible dates; impossible-only schedules reported cleanly rather than hanging/crashing
Invalid -n values (0, negative, non-integer) handled gracefully
